summary:
[image-to-video + combat choreography] The target video begins exactly from <Picture 1>, the armored warrior on a scorched wasteland with twin flame blades, then erupts into a 10-second cinematic melee against six drone-soldiers that emerge from the smoke. The warrior's black-and-silver segmented armor, orange visor, and twin flame blades are preserved from the first frame throughout.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] At 00:00.000 — I2VA first frame holds: the armored warrior stands on the scorched wasteland exactly as in <Picture 1>, black-and-silver segmented armor, orange glowing visor, twin flame blades guttering at his sides, dust and explosion smoke behind him. He shifts weight onto his front foot, drives the ball of that foot into the ground (close-up: boot grinding the ash, a dust ring bursts, radial cracks split the earth), and launches forward in a low dash; the twin blades flare from embers to roaring flame plumes as he tears toward frame-right, leaving a smear of heat-haze afterimages.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500 — Wide. The warrior skims across the blasted field; from the drifting smoke on both flanks six drone-soldiers charge in — charcoal hexagonal stacked torsos, a single red triangular eye, two antenna-like sensors, three-segment scythe arms, reverse-joint clawed legs, red glowing cable-tubes at every joint. He closes on the left pair: a horizontal spinning slash whips the twin blades through both, their torsos shear apart at the waist and the halves tumble away trailing ember sparks and a dust burst where they land. Without pause he blinks sideways (afterimage smear), appears behind a third, hooks a scythe-arm and wrenches it up (metal shriek, orange sparks spray), then a rising reverse slash carves the drone through the waist, the upper half cartwheels off in a spray of cinder. A fourth lunges; the warrior phases past it, twists, and a backhand chain-slash erupts along its spine — the drone detonates into a bloom of flame and scattering debris. EARLY HEAVY (full speed, no slow-mo): he sees the gap, winds the right blade into a full-power sweeping arc, the blade's flame extends into a crescent shockwave that catches a fifth drone and hurls it clear off-frame; the camera whips back in a super-fast pull, the flying drone plows a furrow through a ruined wall, brick and dust fountain up along its path, it slams to a halt embedded in rubble, then the warrior is already rebounding forward. He meets the sixth with crossed blades, parries the scythe (clang, white flash one frame, sparks), and ripostes with a thrust that pierces the core, the red eye flickers and dies as the body slumps.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000 — Low-angle medium. The downed drones' wreckage smolders; the warrior plants and turns to the surviving swarm beyond. SLOW-BEAT (the only slow motion in the film, ~0.6s): he sinks his weight, the air around him ignites into concentric gathering lines, the twin blades draw back in a slow pull of stored fire, his visor's glow narrows to a single lock. The slow beat ends — contact snaps to full speed: he launches forward and the twin blades unleash a crossing light-blade void-slash; the flame arcs meet the lead drone and BURST with decisive damage and destruction together — a radial crater tears open in the earth, the surrounding drones disintegrate into drifting points of light, the lens dives to follow the fall, the impact point blooms the maximum destruction (a ring of flame and pulverized ground), holds on the wreckage panorama for ~0.3s, then ends.

overall_soundscape:
The twin flame blades shriek as they cut the air and hum on the iai draw; metal clangs on parry with a one-frame crack of white flash; torsos shear with a metallic death-knell, rubble thuds as the off-frame drone embeds, brick and stone clatter as the ruined wall is plowed; the boot-stomp kicks up a dust ring and the low dash drags a stream of ash; the flame plumes roar, the void-slash hits with a low-frequency detonation; drone servo-motors whine and hydraulic joints vent underneath it all.

non_diegetic_music:
A tense electronic drone with industrial percussion and brass stabs that swell on the early heavy hit and resolve into a single low sustained note as the final crater blooms.
